raw_segments.text: Mr. Bloom pointed quickly, to catch up and walk behind her if she went slowly behind
Pleasant to see first thing in the morning, hurry up damn it, make hay while the sun shines.
She stood outside the shop in sunlight and sauntered lazily to the right.
He sighed down his nose, they never understand, sawed a chapped hands, crusted toenails too,
brown scapulars in tatters defending her both ways.
The sting of disregard glowed to weak pleasure within his breast.
For another, a constable off-duty cuddling her in Eccles Lane.
They like them sizable, prime sausage.
Oh please, Mr. Policeman, I'm lost in the wood.
